title: hieracium subtardans subsp. amphipolium
intro: Hieracium subtardans subsp. amphipolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and promote the healing of skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
